address: Kinnikuman's register flips with his posture, not with the listener: swaggering 'ta' while posing as a hero, whining 'tớ/con' the moment he is scared, hungry or scolded. Keep both in Vietnamese — the flip is the running joke.

Meat keeps です/ます and 王子 for Kinnikuman in every mood, even while complaining or blaming him. Render as a steady polite 'em/ngài (hoàng tử)'. The rare times he drops to おまえ or barks うるさい! are deliberate breaks — let them show.

Dialect marks the cast: Kansai for Natsuko (うち, 〜んや — she keeps it in every scene), for Franky and for Nachiguron's crying; Kyushu/Hakata for the Zangyaku alien; country speech for Yosaku, the frog monster and old villagers. Give each a distinct Vietnamese regional voice rather than neutral speech, and keep it identical on every reappearance.
Terryman's ミー/ユー is Westernised Japanese, not English dialogue — carry it as one consistent foreign-sounding self term for the whole series, and do not re-invent it per chapter.

The monster of the week is rarely a villain: Nachiguron, the shell monster, Nagaashi Gon, Tendon and the frog monster are all lonely, proud or desperate creatures, and their chapters end in pity or reconciliation. Keep their Vietnamese sympathetic — 'tao/mày' while they bluster, softening to 'em/anh' or a plain 'tôi' when they break down. Flattening them into generic villain-speak loses the point of the series.
Family speech on Kinniku Star is deliberately low and comic: the king says わし/おまえ and スグル, the prince answers パパ. Use plain 'ta/con' and 'ba/con', not royal register.

Volume 3 turns the series into a tournament, and the Hero Olympics fighters are national stereotypes by design (Britain's armoured knight, China's kung-fu devil, Germany's Nazi, India's curry head, Mexico's masked showman). Keep each one's register distinct and period-appropriate rather than levelling them into one 'wrestler voice'.

Broadcast scenes have their own register: the announcer and commentator keep です/ます and さん for everyone, however absurd the action. Keep that formality — the contrast with the fighters' rough speech is the joke.

Westernised pronouns are a marker of foreignness across the whole cast, not a quirk of one character: Terryman (American), Robin Mask and his trainer Gania Mask (English), Kazu Nakano (Nisei) and Duke Kamata (Hawaii promoter) all reach for ミー and ユー. Pick ONE Vietnamese rendering for this and use it for every one of them, so the reader hears 'foreigner' the same way each time.

Anger does not simply strip politeness away — Robin Mask's coldest threat ('死んでもらいます!') keeps the polite ます form, and Meat stays in です/ます even while blaming the prince. Do not flatten every angry line into 'tao/mày'; the politeness held under fury is often the point.

Volume 4 leaves one relationship deliberately unexplained: the scarred おじさん who swore to kill Kinnikuman and then seconded him to the title, and whatever ties him to Natsuko. Keep his address to her ('Natsuko', gọi thẳng tên) and to everyone else exactly as it is — do not smooth it into a settled uncle/niece register until the story says so.

Titles, not names, carry rank in this cast, and the title is what should be translated: 王子 (Hoàng tử) for Kinnikuman among everyone who knows who he is — aliens, monsters, palace staff and Meat alike; 先生 (tiên sinh) for Kinkotsuman; 委員長 for the Olympic chairman; 長官 for the Defense Force chief; 会長 (hội trưởng/chủ tịch) for Doro Flairs and Iyadesu Harisun. Characters who use his real name スグル — Natsuko when she is proud of him, his father, and Skull Bose when he wants to see him flinch — are doing something pointed; keep 'Suguru' there.

Volume 5's three American bodies are told apart by voice, not by badge, and the four leaders must never blur: Sheik Seijin (WSF) growls わし/おまえ with 〜じゃ; his champion Skull Bose keeps です/ます and a dry フフフフ even while planning a murder; Beauty Rhodes (WSC champion) is affected and feminine-coded — ホホホホホ, わよ/のよ, speaking of himself in the third person; Iyadesu Harisun (WSC chairman) is flat corporate です/ます. Give each a Vietnamese register that holds for the whole arc; the factions are legible to the reader only through these voices.

When Kinnikuman is undercover as 'Chanel Man' he speaks in a different voice — オレ and street slang instead of his usual わたし. Keep the two voices distinct in Vietnamese, and let the disguise crack audibly at the moments he forgets (blurting 'パパ!' at his father's portrait), because those slips are the plot.

characters.name: Kinnikuman
characters.role: The hero of the series: a clumsy, self-important superhero who turns out to be the exiled prince of Kinniku Star. Volumes 3–4 are the Hero Olympics (超人オリンピック), which he enters as Japan's representative and — against every expectation, his own included — **wins**, beating Robin Mask in the final. Volume 4 ends with him on a champion's world tour, starting in Hawaii. Volume 5 is his American tour: he loses to the old master Kamehame in seven seconds, is thrown out of Jesse Mayvia's gym, and is rebuilt by Kamehame into 'a body like steel' before taking the Hawaii belt in a no-rope death match — then hands the belt straight back to his teacher and swims to California because he gave the prize money away too. In America he works undercover for Doro Flairs as 'Chanel Man', wrecking rival champions to set the WSF and WSC at each other's throats, and nearly gives himself away by blurting 'パパ!' at a photograph of his own father. The volume ends at the Grand Canyon: offered a guaranteed title defence by pushing a broken Robin Mask into the gorge, he refuses — and then blows the ring apart to save him.
characters.personality: Boastful and posturing in public, cowardly and whiny the moment things go wrong; childish with his father, jealous of any hero more famous than him, and an incorrigible skirt-chaser. Genuinely soft-hearted underneath: he takes in the monsters he beats, mourns the ones that die, and goes to help even when the law forbids it. His wins come from 火事場のバカ力 — blind survival instinct — not skill, and he often cannot remember afterwards what he did.
characters.speech: Plain, rough Japanese (わたし, おまえ, バカヤロウ, コンニャロー) that keeps slipping into mock-formal です/ます when he strikes a heroic pose — the mismatch is the joke ('への つっぱりはいらんですよ!'). Laughs ヌフフフ / ヌハハハ when pleased, shouts ヌオオ〜〜 when angry, and yells シュワッチ (Ultraman parody) when he attacks. Keeps boasting 'actually I'm good at THIS one' after every defeat. In Vietnamese: swaggering 'ta' in front of a crowd, whining 'tớ/con' when scared or begging, polite 'tôi' only when courting Mari. Breaks the fourth wall to complain straight to 読者のみなさん (quý độc giả) when things go badly — keep that as direct address to the reader. In volume 5 he also carries a second voice: while disguised as 'Chanel Man' he drops to オレ and street-rough slang (ケッ…, わかりゃしねぇ, 冗談じゃねえ), a deliberate break from his usual わたし. Keep the disguise audible in Vietnamese — a coarser 'tao' with clipped slang — and let it slip back whenever he forgets himself.
selfTerms: ta (わたし, posing as a hero, to strangers and monsters)
tôi (わたくし, です/ます, being formal to impress — to Mari, to officials)
con (to his father, パパ — childish, wheedling)
tớ (whining, crying, begging Meat)

relations.relation: the WSA chairman who employs him and sends him undercover

characters.name: Mít (Meat)
characters.role: Herald from Kinniku Star who reveals Kinnikuman's royal birth and then stays on Earth as his second, manager and conscience; a small boy in glasses and cape who attends Suminoe kindergarten (running gag) and secretly works night shifts to pay their way. Through volume 5 he is at the prince's shoulder for the whole American tour, disguised alongside him as part of the Chanel Man cover, buying toy sunglasses because there are five dollars left in the budget, and — at the Grand Canyon — urging Kinnikuman to throw Robin into the gorge because 'a champion has to be ruthless'. He is overruled.
characters.personality: Devoted, sensible and long-suffering — the adult in the household despite being a child. Mutters about the prince's moods, takes the blame, and stands up to him only to defend someone weaker. By volume 2 he also teases the prince outright, setting him up for pratfalls and needling him about his failed romances.
characters.speech: Keeps です/ます with Kinnikuman almost always, calling him 王子 / 王子さま; self term ぼく, sliding to わたくし when very formal and to a childish わし when he sulks and wants the same treatment as the prince. Loves the ニクイ / 肉 pun. In Vietnamese: 'em/ngài' or 'em/hoàng tử', polite register kept even while complaining. Rarely drops to a blunt おまえ — when he does (an うるさい! or a worried 'おまえだから心配なんじゃねえか'), it marks a real break in the usual deference; keep the shift visible in Vietnamese.
selfTerms: em (ぼく, với Kinnikuman và người lớn, giữ です/ます)
con (わたくし, lễ phép với cô giáo Mari)
tớ (わし, nũng nịu, đòi công bằng — hiếm)

relations.relation: his prince and master, whom he serves, scolds and covers for

relations.relation: the American hero who treats him as a friend
relations.address: em/anh Terryman (gọi thẳng tên, hớt hải) khi cảnh báo nguy hiểm; giữ です/ます lịch sự khi giải thích, từ chối lời rủ

relations.relation: the reporter who treats him as a little brother
relations.address: em/chị — ngắn gọn, thân mật, không kính ngữ

relations.relation: the king, who drills and scolds him while they train the prince
relations.address: em/Đại vương (大王さま, です/ます) — lễ phép nhưng dám càu nhàu lại

relations.relation: the fallen champion he walks through the prison corridor with, then screams a warning to
relations.address: em/anh Robin — hoảng loạn gọi gộp 'Vương tử, Robin, chạy đi!' khi máy bay lao xuống

characters.name: Robin Mask
characters.role: Britain's armoured champion — full plate armour and a closed knight's helmet. He won the previous Hero Olympics and returns as defending champion, first treating Kinnikuman as a disposable sparring partner, then beating a wounded Terryman on a technicality and withdrawing rather than take a hollow win. In the final against Kinnikuman he loses his mask, loses his temper, and finally loses the match to a reversed backbreaker. He takes the silver, declines Kinnikuman's offer of a home in Japan, and leaves on his own tour with his wife Alisa — admitting he is simply tired of being champion. Volume 5 breaks him. Stripped of the title, he has left his wife Alisa, been picked up by Sheik Seijin and used as a piece by the Alliance; he no longer remembers his own life and mistakes his opponent for Kinnikuman mid-match. He smuggles food into Kinnikuman's cell, goads him into the Grand Canyon title match, feints with the sight of Alisa in the crowd, and finally offers himself to be thrown into the gorge so his friend can keep the belt. When Kinnikuman refuses, he calls him a fool and tries to finish him with the Tower Bridge.
characters.personality: Haughty and condescending, but fundamentally honourable — he refuses a win he does not think he earned, and concedes cleanly when beaten. Under real humiliation (his mask torn off in front of a crowd) that control snaps and he turns genuinely murderous, which is the arc of the final.
characters.speech: His register is the most nuanced in the cast and is easy to get wrong. Baseline: formal わたし with キミ for the listener, reflective and polite. Under strain he drops to blunt rough forms — だぜ while he has a hold locked on, 許さん and おれん when furious, アンポンタンめ when jeering. But he does NOT simply abandon politeness with anger: his coldest line, announcing he will kill Kinnikuman, keeps the polite ます form — 「死んでもらいます!」. Being English, he also reaches for Westernised ユーたち. In Vietnamese: 'ta/cậu' quý tộc trịch thượng làm nền, gằn xuống 'tao/mày' khi đang khoá đòn hoặc điên tiết — nhưng câu doạ giết phải giữ vẻ lịch sự lạnh gáy ('mời cậu chết đi' chứ không phải 'tao giết mày'), vì chính chỗ lịch sự đó mới rợn.
selfTerms: ta (わたし, trịch thượng, mặc định)
tao (khi khoá đòn hoặc nổi điên)
Mi (ユー, kiểu Tây hoá, hiếm)

relations.relation: the prince's herald, who he snaps at across the ring
relations.address: ta/thằng ngốc (バカモノ, わい) — cộc cằn, khinh miệt

characters.name: Vua Kinniku (King Muscle)
characters.role: King of Kinniku Star and Kinnikuman's father; lost his throne to King Tone. In volume 3 he comes to Earth as his son's cornerman — pleading with the Olympic committee to let Japan compete, then drilling, panicking over and cheering for him from ringside.
characters.personality: Blustering, self-pitying and shameless — wheedles, bribes with gyudon, then shouts 親不孝者め when refused. Softens when speaking of Meat's sacrifices for his son.
characters.speech: Old-man plain speech, self term わし, calls his son by his real name スグル or おまえ. In Vietnamese: 'ta/con', rough and familiar, with a whining edge when he wants something.
selfTerms: ta (わし, với mọi người)

relations.relation: his son, the prince he abandoned on Earth and now needs
relations.address: ta/con, gọi thẳng tên 'Suguru' (わし/おまえ, スグル) mặc định; van nài, dỗ ngọt bằng cơm bò; quát 'thằng con bất hiếu' (親不孝者め) khi bị từ chối; trầm giọng nghiêm túc khi kể chuyện Meat hi sinh

relations.relation: his son's herald, whom he drills alongside him
relations.address: ta/Mít (ミートくん) — quát tháo trong lúc huấn luyện, lo lắng khi cần tin tức

relations.relation: the committee head who humiliates him
relations.address: ta/ông — nài nỉ rồi phẫn nộ khi bị gạt phắt và bị chê là 'nỗi nhục của Nhật Bản'

relations.relation: the official who taunts him about his son
relations.address: ta/cậu Mayumi — quát nạt, tát thẳng rồi viện điều lệ số 264

characters.name: Terryman
characters.role: American wrestler-hero from Texas who charges money for hero work. Across volumes 2–3 he turns from rival into Kinnikuman's closest ally: he confesses his love to Natsuko, takes Kinkotsuman's rifle bullet in the leg to save Kinnikuman, and then fights the Olympic semifinal against Robin Mask on that ruined leg.
characters.personality: Cool, professional and mercenary on the surface — he says plainly he does not work for free — but volumes 2 and 3 give him the series' first real heart: he loves Natsuko, he takes a bullet for a rival, and he fights hurt rather than withdraw. He also fights dirty when cornered (a hidden knuckle-duster against Robin Mask), and is ashamed of it afterwards.
characters.speech: Mixes Westernised pronouns ミー (me) and ユー (you) into Japanese — his signature, used sparingly and mostly when he is being superior or teasing. Otherwise polite です/ます with strangers and a rough おれ when he means business; drops English tags ('ベリーナイス') when pleased. In Vietnamese: keep the foreign flavour with a consistent rendering of ミー/ユー across the whole series — pick one and never vary it.
selfTerms: ミー = tôi (kiểu Tây hoá, giữ nét ngoại quốc khi dịch)

relations.relation: the reporter he charms, then falls genuinely in love with
relations.address: tôi/cô (わたし/おじょうさん, です/ます) khi tán tỉnh khéo; gọi thẳng tên tha thiết 'Natsuko' khi van xin và thổ lộ — 'ナツコを愛している‼'

relations.relation: Kinnikuman's boy herald, whom he treats as a pal
relations.address: tôi/Mít (ミートくん) — thân thiện, rủ đi chơi như bạn bè

relations.relation: the island princess who hires him for money

relations.address: tôi/anh — căng thẳng đối đầu; hoảng hốt van nài 'đừng đứng dậy nữa' khi sợ thua; nhận suất chung kết trong ngượng ngùng

relations.relation: the villain whose sniper bullet he took in the leg
relations.address: tôi/hắn (キン骨マン, gọi thẳng tên) — kể lại vụ bắn lén bằng giọng nghiêm trọng, đau đớn

characters.name: Natsuko
characters.role: Reporter and photographer for 週刊HERO magazine, which runs a reader-voted hero ranking that puts Kinnikuman last. She meets him chasing the Kappatoron story and then stays — covering his fights, photographing Terryman, and being turned into a giantess by Kinkotsuman's Monster Gun. After Mari, the second woman in Kinnikuman's orbit and the more constant presence.
characters.personality: Brash, fearless and teasing — she mocks Kinnikuman's failures to his face, then swings to open admiration once she watches him fight. Jealous and sharp-tongued with Mari, professionally pushy with her editor.
characters.speech: Kansai dialect throughout: self term うち, endings 〜んや/〜へん, あんた for the listener. Switches to a formal わたくし + です/ます only when introducing herself as a reporter, and swears freely (バッキャロー) when angry. In Vietnamese: give her one consistent regional voice (suồng sã 'tui/anh'), never neutral polite speech — the dialect is half the character.
selfTerms: tui (うち, giọng Kansai, thường ngày)
tôi (わたくし, です/ます, khi tự giới thiệu với tư cách phóng viên)
tụi mình (うちら, khi nói gộp cả nhóm)

relations.relation: the hero she covers, mocks, then champions
relations.address: tui/anh (うち/あんた, giọng Kansai) mặc định; gọi thẳng tên thật 'Suguru' (スグル) khi tự hào khoe với đám đông; biệt danh thân mật 'Kin' (キンちゃん) khi nhắc tới anh với người khác; quát 'đồ khốn' (バッキャロー) khi anh đập phá đồ của cô

relations.relation: the American hero she photographs and openly admires
relations.address: em/anh Terryman (わたし/テリーマンさん) — ngưỡng mộ, hơi say mê; bỏ さん gọi trống 'anh' (あなた) khi chủ động rủ chụp ảnh chung

relations.relation: her rival for Kinnikuman's attention
relations.address: tui/cô ta (gọi trống, mỉa mai) — ghen tị, châm chọc vẻ trong sáng giả tạo

relations.relation: Kinnikuman's boy herald, whom she treats as a little brother
relations.address: tui/Mít (ミートくん) — suồng sã, thân mật

characters.name: Kinkotsuman
characters.role: Skeleton-themed alien from 「しゃれこうべ星」 and the series' recurring villain. Volumes 3–4 reveal he is also the bone-faced mastermind sabotaging the Hero Olympics: an invisibility ray, a voice-command mic, a fake referee, a rifle shot from the stands that hit Terryman instead, and two attempts to kidnap Kinnikuman before the weigh-in. His henchmen call him 先生. He is chased off by the space police but always escapes.
characters.personality: Grandiose and gloating while winning, snivelling and tearful the instant he loses, and never done vowing revenge. His underlings and even crowds call him 先生 — he is a celebrity as much as a villain.
characters.speech: Archaic villain register (じゃ, さらばじゃ, 貴様), signature rasping cackle ムヒョヒョ, and a childish sobbing わ~ん when beaten. In Vietnamese: lối nói ác nhân cổ trang 'ta/lũ ngươi', rồi mếu máo như trẻ con khi thua — chính chỗ tương phản đó là trò đùa.
selfTerms: ta (giọng ác nhân, じゃ/貴様)

relations.relation: his arch-enemy
relations.address: ta/lũ ngươi (おまえたち, gộp cả Mít) khi ngạo mạn; gọi thẳng tên 'Kinnikuman' khi đắc thắng lộ bẫy; thua vẫn gằn 'ここのうらみはわすれんからな!'

relations.relation: his round-bodied lackey
relations.address: ta/Iwao (gọi thẳng tên) — sai khiến, khen thưởng cộc lốc ('でかしたぞイワオ!')

relations.relation: the hero who took his sniper bullet
relations.address: ta/mày — bắn lén từ khán đài, không đối mặt

relations.relation: his rock-faced lieutenant
relations.address: ta/mày — gắt gỏng, sai khiến; nhận báo cáo trinh sát

characters.name: Ramenman
characters.role: China's representative, billed as the 東洋の悪魔 (Oriental Devil). He kills Brockenman in the ring, fights Kinnikuman on an ice ring, and is disqualified from the third-place match for fouling Terryman with a chained weapon. Afterwards he reveals he once lost a death-match to Kinnikuman, and demands — half furious, half pleading — that Kinnikuman take the final seriously instead of trusting to luck, or his own defeat will have meant nothing.
characters.personality: Cold and genuinely cruel in the ring, and a showman about it — but volume 4 gives him pride and hurt underneath: he needs the man who beat him to be worth having lost to.
characters.speech: Triumphant cackle だはははは; mocking nicknames for opponents (曲芸師 'acrobat' for Kinnikuman dodging along the ropes). In Vietnamese: 'ta/mày' lạnh lùng, tàn nhẫn — giữ tiếng cười đắc thắng và lối gọi giễu.
selfTerms: ta (lạnh lùng, tàn nhẫn)

relations.relation: his Block B opponent on the ice ring
relations.address: ta/'tay làm xiếc' (曲芸師) — giễu cợt khi đối thủ nhảy nhót né đòn

characters.name: Doro Flairs
characters.role: Chairman (会長) of the World Superhuman Association (世界超人協会 / WSA), the body that invited Kinnikuman to America. Volume 5's American arc is his war: driven out of Los Angeles and then St. Louis by the rival WSF and WSC, he rebuilds at the hidden 'Supermen World' park in a Missouri canyon and sets Kinnikuman to work undercover as 'Chanel Man', beating up rival champions to make the two other bodies blame each other. The plan works, and by the volume's end he is openly scheming with the enemy champion Skull Bose and watching the Grand Canyon ring explode with satisfaction.
characters.personality: A showman and a schemer in equal parts — he builds a superhuman museum and a Disneyland knock-off out of genuine sentiment for dead wrestlers, then spends the same breath plotting. Boastful about his park, maudlin about the past, and entirely willing to spend Kinnikuman as a game piece. Treat his warmth as real and his loyalty as conditional; the volume ends without telling you which side he is on.
characters.speech: Old man's register: わし for himself, ordinary plain forms, 〜じゃ / 〜のう endings. Ranges from tour-guide enthusiasm to sour muttering (キン肉マンめ なにをやっとるんだ). Gives orders flatly in the rough きさま when he is being the boss, and calls Kinnikuman by name with a dismissive め when complaining about him behind his back. In Vietnamese: a self-important 'ta' or 'lão' with an old man's ease, turning curt and cold when he issues orders.
selfTerms: ta / lão (わし, mặc định)
chúng ta (わしら, khi nói thay cả WSA)

relations.relation: the champion he invited to America and then used as an undercover weapon against the rival bodies
relations.address: ta/ngươi (わし/きさま) khi ra lệnh, nghiêm giọng bề trên; 'cái thằng Kinnikuman này' (キン肉マンめ) khi càu nhàu sau lưng; 'các ngươi' (キミたち) khi hài lòng khen ngầm cả hai thầy trò

relations.relation: the enemy body's champion he ends up scheming with
relations.address: ta/Skull (スカル, gọi trống tên, không kính ngữ) — xẳng giọng chất vấn, rồi khen 'スカルよくやったぞ' khi vừa ý

relations.relation: the fallen champion he tries to buy
relations.address: ta/ông (gọi đủ 'ロビン・マスク') — lịch sự có tính mua chuộc

relations.relation: the henchman he sends to crash the plane into the ring
relations.address: ta/Iwao (gọi trống tên, ra lệnh cộc lốc)

characters.name: Bình luận viên dẫn
characters.role: Young afro-haired ringside announcer calling the play-by-play of the Hero Olympics broadcast, paired with an older commentator.
characters.personality: Professional, unflappable, keeps the broadcast moving through absurdity.
characters.speech: Broadcast です/ます throughout, names everyone with さん. In Vietnamese: 'tôi/anh, ông' lịch sự kiểu truyền hình — giữ giọng tường thuật trang trọng bất kể chuyện trên sàn có vô lý đến đâu.
selfTerms: tôi (です/ます)

relations.relation: the champion he interviews at ringside
relations.address: tôi/anh Robin (ロビンさん, です/ます) — lịch sự, trang trọng trước ống kính

relations.relation: his broadcast partner
relations.address: tôi/ông Tazahama (タザハマさん, です/ます) — lịch sự mời bình luận

characters.name: Mari
characters.role: Nursery teacher (保母) at Suminoe kindergarten, Meat's teacher, and Kinnikuman's love interest from the 'かわいいキッスの巻' chapter on; quietly cooks breakfast for the pair.
characters.personality: Warm, unflappable, faintly amused by Kinnikuman; kind to Meat like a teacher to a small pupil. Has a sharp side too — she rounds on Kinnikuman when he abuses a rescue for a grope, and trades barbs with Natsuko.
characters.speech: です/ます, self term あたし / わたし, calls people by name + くん/さん. In Vietnamese: 'em/anh' with Kinnikuman, 'cô/Mít' with Meat.
selfTerms: em (あたし, với Kinnikuman)
cô (わたし, với Mít và trẻ mẫu giáo)

relations.relation: the odd neighbour-hero who courts her
relations.address: em/anh (あたし/あなた, です/ます) — tò mò rồi ngạc nhiên thích thú khi biết anh nổi tiếng

relations.relation: her pupil at the kindergarten
relations.address: cô/Mít (わたし/ミートくん) — thân mật kiểu cô giáo với học trò nhỏ, âu yếm khi cảm ơn

relations.relation: her rival for Kinnikuman's attention
relations.address: em/cô (わたし/あなた, です/ます nhưng gằn giọng) — khó chịu khi bị dò hỏi; châm chọc ngược 'わたしで69人めだ!' khi bị xúc phạm

characters.name: Ông chú (chưa rõ tên)
characters.role: A gruff, scarred man in a plaid shirt who appears at the end of volume 3 telling Natsuko 「おれはキン肉マンを殺す……!」 and manhandling her until Terryman intervenes — then, across volume 4, quietly becomes Kinnikuman's ringside second: he feeds him the tactics that beat Robin Mask, protests Robin's sneak attack from the stands, thaws Robin with a defrost gun, restrains a panicking Meat, and consoles Robin after the silver medal. Everyone calls him おじさん. **His name and what he is to Natsuko are still unexplained at the end of volume 4** — the biggest open thread in the series so far.
characters.personality: Starts as a threat and turns into the group's gruff uncle: blunt, practical, protective of everyone including his former target, and the only adult who talks sense at ringside.
characters.speech: Rough おれ and bare imperatives when angry (殺してやるーっ!!, ヘイ とにかく きくんだ‼), but he keeps です/ます with King Muscle even while calling him おじさん. In Vietnamese: 'tao/mày' lúc hung hãn, chuyển sang 'tôi/ông' cộc lốc mà lễ phép với bậc trên, và 'chú/cháu' với Mít và Terryman.
selfTerms: tao (おれ, lúc hung hãn)
tôi (khi nói với King Muscle, giữ です/ます)
chú (với Mít, Terryman)

relations.relation: the woman he threatened over Kinnikuman — the connection is never explained
relations.address: tao/Natsuko (gọi thẳng tên) — gầm lên đầy hận thù, ghì chặt không buông

relations.relation: the man he swore to kill, then seconded to the championship
relations.address: tao/Kinnikuman (gọi thẳng tên) — gấp gáp, ra lệnh ở sát dây đài, ép nghe chiến thuật

relations.relation: his man's opponent, whom he defends, rescues and then consoles
relations.address: tôi/Robin Mask (gọi đủ tên) khi phẫn nộ tố cáo đánh úp; 'Robin' rút gọn, dịu hẳn khi cứu và an ủi

relations.relation: the king he guides and argues with at the stadium
relations.address: tôi/ông (おじさん thân mật nhưng giữ ですか lịch sự) — vừa can ngăn vừa lo thật lòng cho con trai ông

relations.relation: the boy he calms down
relations.address: chú/Mít (ミートくん) — ghì giữ, trấn an bằng giọng thân thiết

relations.relation: a hero he already seems to know
relations.address: chú/cậu Terryman (テリーマンくん) — thân mật như quen từ trước

characters.name: Jesse Mayvia
characters.role: Hawaii champion and owner of the Jesse Palace gym, defending his belt for the 999th time when Kinnikuman challenges him. He years ago stole the championship from Kamehame and kept him on as a valet, which is the grudge the whole Hawaii arc turns on. In the double-title 'no-rope death match' he is nicknamed BIG MOUNTAIN for a defence nothing can move, until Kinnikuman's feigned despair draws him out and the 48 Killer Techniques finish him.
characters.personality: Contemptuous and image-conscious — he throws Kinnikuman out of his gym for losing, sneers at his 'pig body', and rigs the rules (removing the ropes) rather than fight straight. Arrogant enough to be careless at the exact moment it costs him the match.
characters.speech: わたし, plain and clipped, with a champion's condescension; rough dismissals (バカもの!, 負け犬はキライだ) and a sneering フフフ. Uses くん and 王子 for Kinnikuman when he is being falsely gracious. In Vietnamese: a cold, superior 'ta', dropping to open contempt 'tao/mày' when he taunts.
selfTerms: ta (わたし, mặc định, giọng bề trên)
chúng ta (わしたち/わたしたち khi đại diện phe mình)

relations.relation: the visiting champion he despises, then loses both belts to
relations.address: ta/(không gọi tên) khinh miệt, 'đồ ngu' (バカもの!) khi gắt; ta/cậu Meibia… ngược lại, gọi 'vương tử' (王子) hoặc thêm くん khi làm ra vẻ lịch thiệp trước đám đông

relations.relation: his manager and fixer
relations.address: ta/Kamata (gọi trống tên, plain) — tin cậy, bàn mưu ngang hàng

relations.relation: the man he took the belt from and kept as his valet
relations.address: ta/(gọi trống, khinh) — coi như người hầu, không bao giờ gọi bằng tên tôn trọng

characters.name: Tazahama
characters.role: Older bald, bespectacled commentator beside the announcer, whipping up excitement with a hand-drum.
characters.personality: Excitable and easily deflated; keeps his manners even when Robin Mask picks him up by the ankles mid-broadcast.
characters.speech: です/ます, gushing ガンバレガンバレ, polite even when sulking ('そ…それだけですか…ありがとうございました'). In Vietnamese: 'tôi/anh' lịch sự, hào hứng quá đà rồi hụt hẫng.
selfTerms: tôi (わたし, です/ます)

relations.relation: the champion he tries to interview
relations.address: tôi/anh Robin (ロビンさん, です/ます) — lịch sự; giãy nảy 'わー ゆするな' khi bị túm chân đùa nghịch

characters.name: Kamehame
characters.role: The old Hawaiian master who becomes Kinnikuman's teacher — the volume's emotional spine. Introduced as Jesse Mayvia's shabby valet, he beats the world champion in seven seconds, then reveals he is the man Mayvia robbed of the Hawaii belt and has been waiting years to take it back. He trains Kinnikuman into 'a body like steel' and hands down the 48 Killer Techniques (48の殺人技). When Kinnikuman wins and gives him the belt, he says his part is done and walks away.
characters.personality: Rough-looking, shaggy and bearded, but calm, courteous and deliberate — the contrast is the point. Carries an old defeat without self-pity, teaches by plain instruction rather than shouting, and lets his student inherit the dream he can no longer finish himself.
characters.speech: わたし for himself and キミ or the plain name キン肉マン for his student; long sentences, trailing 「…」, an old man's 〜のう. Switches into textbook です/ます when explaining technique, and teases in the same polite register (だからバカ王子っていわれるんですよ). In Vietnamese: a steady, unhurried 'ta' or 'thầy' with 'con/cậu' for Kinnikuman — warmth without sentimentality.
selfTerms: ta / thầy (わたし, trầm, điềm đạm)

relations.relation: his student and the heir to his unfinished dream
relations.address: thầy/con (わたし/キミ, キン肉マン) mặc định, trầm tĩnh; chuyển sang giọng giảng bài lịch sự (です/ます) khi dạy đòn, vẫn giọng đó khi trêu 'vương tử dở hơi'; nghiêm giọng ra lệnh 'よくきけ' lúc mách nước giữa trận

relations.relation: the man who took his belt and made him a valet
relations.address: ta/hắn (やつ) — nói về chứ hiếm khi nói với; giọng nén, không gào

characters.name: Skull Bose
characters.role: Champion of the Superhuman Alliance (超人同盟 / WSF) — bald, tattooed head to foot with the word SUKARU, and the most dangerous mind in the American arc. He takes the West from the WSA, sends his tattooed thugs to seize its headquarters, headlines the WSF's lethal Lumberjack Show, and personally sets the trap that exposes 'Chanel Man', going undercover in a deerstalker and round glasses to do it. By the volume's end the rigged plane crash has made him the new world champion.
characters.personality: Polite, patient and entirely ruthless — he vouches for Kinnikuman in public while building the trap that will unmask him. Takes decisions over his own chairman's head. He is the one who calls Kinnikuman by his real name スグル to watch his face.
characters.speech: The key to him: he keeps です/ます in every scene, including while plotting murder, and finishes on a dry フフフフ. Rough slang (ヤロウ, 〜ぜ) only when he drops the mask. Calls his chairman シーク flatly or シークさま when he wants something. In Vietnamese: a smooth, unfailingly polite 'tôi' — do NOT coarsen him when he turns cruel; the politeness held over the cruelty is the character.
selfTerms: tôi (わたし, です/ます, giữ nguyên kể cả khi bàn chuyện độc ác)

relations.relation: his chairman, whom he manages as much as he serves
relations.address: tôi/Sheik (わたし/シーク, です/ます) — lịch sự nhưng cứng rắn khi biện hộ; nâng lên 'ngài Sheik' (シークさま) khi trấn an hoặc cần được cho qua

relations.relation: the infiltrator he protects in public and traps in private
relations.address: tôi/Chanel Man (シャネルマン) trước mặt mọi người, quát 'いいかげんにしろ' khi cần diễn; gọi thẳng tên thật 'cậu Suguru' (スグルくん) khi dò phản ứng — đó là lúc nguy hiểm nhất

relations.relation: the rival chairman he ends up scheming with
relations.address: tôi/(không gọi tên, です/ます) — trình bày mưu kế như báo cáo công việc

characters.name: Sheik Seijin
characters.role: Chairman of the Superhuman Alliance (超人同盟 / WSF), the body the public calls the Superhuman Mafia — it runs the Lumberjack Show, where superhumans kill each other for a betting crowd. He allies with the WSC to destroy the WSA, then falls out with it over who gets to deal with 'Chanel Man', and it is he who picks up the broken Robin Mask and turns him into a piece on the board.
characters.personality: Blunt, territorial and openly contemptuous — he throws the wounded Beauty Rhodes at his allies' feet as a 'gift'. Given to grand philosophical talk about good and evil while running a death show. Impatient with his own champion's slow scheming.
characters.speech: わし / わしら, rough plain forms, 〜じゃ, and freely insulting (おまえ, きさまら, 肥満体 for Beauty Rhodes). Calls people by bare name plus よ — フレアースよ, スカルよ. In Vietnamese: a coarse, overbearing 'ta/lão' with 'mày/tụi bay' for anyone he does not fear — the opposite pole from Skull Bose's politeness, and the two should never sound alike.
selfTerms: ta / lão (わし)
tụi tao (わしら, khi nói thay WSF)

relations.relation: his champion, who increasingly acts without him
relations.address: ta/Skull à (スカルよ, gọi trống kèm よ, bề trên) — thúc giục, chất vấn

relations.relation: the rival chairman he hunts out of two cities
relations.address: ta/lão Flairs (フレアースよ, おまえ) — xấc xược, gọi trống tên

relations.relation: the allied champion he mocks and then maims
relations.address: ta/mày (おまえ) — mỉa mai, gọi 'thân hình béo phì' (肥満体)

relations.relation: the infiltrator he suspects from the first day
relations.address: tụi tao/tụi bay (わしら/きさまら) khi tố cáo; 'mày' (おまえ) giễu cợt khi vạch vỏ bọc

characters.name: Chủ tịch Ban tổ chức
characters.role: Portly, bearded head of the Hero Olympics committee, who rules Japan out of the tournament once Ultraman declines, sneers at King Muscle's pleas — then personally delivers the news when Kinnikuman is picked after all.
characters.personality: Pompous and cruel when he has the upper hand, all smiles once the decision goes the other way.
characters.speech: Self term わし with a contemptuous おまえ/キサマ downward, booming わっはっはっは. In Vietnamese: 'ta/ngươi' trịch thượng khi gạt phắt, đổi sang 'ta/cậu' hồ hởi khi báo tin vui.
selfTerms: ta (わし)

relations.relation: the foreign king he humiliates
relations.address: ta/ngươi (おまえ, キサマ) — coi thường, cười khẩy 'それこそ日本の恥ですわ!'

relations.relation: the fighter he eventually selects
relations.address: ta/cậu (わし/キミ) — hồ hởi chúc mừng khi báo tin được chọn

characters.name: Beauty Rhodes
characters.nameJa: ビューティー・ローデス
characters.role: Champion of the Superhuman Council (超人評議会 / WSC) and 'the Emperor of New York' — blonde, curled, in a fur cloak and a studded eagle belt, defending his title at Madison Square Garden with an elbow drop off the top rope. Kinnikuman, disguised as Chanel Man, floors him in the crowd; later Sheik Seijin beats him bloody and dumps him in front of his own chairman, which turns the manufactured WSC–WSF quarrel into a real one.
characters.personality: Vain and theatrical, playing the star at every moment; genuinely a top-class wrestler under the posing, which is why his humiliation lands so hard.
characters.speech: Affected, feminine-coded register despite being male — ホホホホホ laughter, わよ / のよ endings, speaking of himself in the third person. Deliberately the opposite of Sheik Seijin's だ/じゃ growl. In Vietnamese: an arch, preening voice — 'ta' with drawn-out flourishes; keep the mannerism, and keep it consistent, because the contrast between the two camps' voices is how the reader tells the factions apart.
selfTerms: ta (điệu đà, hay tự gọi tên mình ở ngôi thứ ba)

relations.relation: nominal ally, then the man who maims him
relations.address: ta/anh Sheik (シーク, gọi trống tên) — xẵng nhưng vẫn õng ẹo, tranh phần trước

relations.relation: the rival chairman he cuts off mid-sentence
relations.address: ta/ông (không gọi tên) — ngạo mạn, cười ホホホホホ

characters.name: Gania Mask
characters.role: Robin Mask's personal trainer and second — bald, deeply lined, built like a bull in a plain tracksuit. Rides a bicycle beside his pupil on training runs, fields the press for him, and in the final breaks through the crowd to warn Kinnikuman that Robin means to kill him.
characters.personality: Gruff, loyal and increasingly frightened of what his own pupil is becoming; the one person who tries to stop the final going too far.
characters.speech: Blunt plain speech with his pupil, shouting バカモノ〜ッ at anyone flippant; despite being an older Englishman he uses the Westernised ユー for Kinnikuman. In Vietnamese: 'tôi/cậu' cộc cằn mà tận tuỵ, giữ cách gọi kiểu Tây hoá đúng như Terryman và Robin Mask.
selfTerms: tôi (cộc cằn)

relations.relation: his pupil
relations.address: tôi/Robin (gọi tên rút gọn) — lo lắng gọi tên; kinh hãi khi đoán ra học trò sắp tung đòn cấm

relations.relation: his pupil's opponent, whom he runs to warn
relations.address: tôi/cậu (ユー, kiểu Tây hoá) — hớt hải: 'ロビンはユーを殺すつもりだ!!'

relations.relation: the commentator he rounds on
relations.address: tôi/đồ ngốc (バカモノ) — quát mắng và giẫm lên ông ta vì buông lời khen thản nhiên trước một đòn chết người

characters.name: Duke Kamata
characters.role: Jesse Mayvia's manager and promoter in Hawaii — bald, moustached, in a white suit, at his champion's shoulder through the whole Hawaii arc, arguing rules and working the crowd.
characters.personality: A fixer: smooth in public, sour in private, quick to quibble over regulations when it suits his man.
characters.speech: Plain, businesslike, なにかね when prompted; reaches for Westernised ミー/ユー like the other foreign cast. In Vietnamese: a brisk 'tôi', deferential to Jesse and dismissive of everyone else.
selfTerms: tôi (plain, giọng quản lý)

relations.relation: his champion and employer
relations.address: tôi/anh (không gọi tên) — chờ lệnh, hỏi lại ngắn 'なにかね'

characters.name: Iwao
characters.role: Round-bodied, goggle-eyed lackey to Kinkotsuman; fetches Kinnikuman's victims as 'material' for the Monster Gun, works the device, and cheers the resulting kaiju on from the sidelines.
characters.personality: Eager, fawning, delighted by his own usefulness.
characters.speech: Deferential 先生 with です/ます upward, excitable shouting at the monsters he handles. In Vietnamese: 'em/tiên sinh' xun xoe với cấp trên.
selfTerms: em (với Kinkotsuman)

relations.relation: his master
relations.address: em/tiên sinh (先生) — lễ phép báo cáo, xin ý kiến ('いかがでしょうか先生!')

characters.name: Mayumi
characters.role: Bearded caped official-cum-competitor at the Hero Olympics — works the microphone before the seeding draw, gets scolded from the judges' box for growing giant, and is drafted to help lift the living-monster barbell. Addressed by everyone as 真弓くん.
characters.personality: Willing, put-upon, a little ridiculous.
characters.speech: Ordinary plain speech; addressed with くん by superiors. In Vietnamese: 'tôi/anh', và để người khác gọi anh ta là 'cậu Mayumi'.
selfTerms: tôi

characters.name: Công chúa Kunta
characters.role: Princess of the southern Roots Island (ルーツ島), who flies in on her pet bird Miss Karasu to beg Kinnikuman to drive three monsters off her island; she knows his royal identity and calls him 王子.
characters.personality: Earnest and dignified, but desperate enough to promise any sum; her island pays in useless giant stone money.
characters.speech: です/ます, self term わたし, addresses Kinnikuman by his title 王子. In Vietnamese: 'em/hoàng tử', lễ phép, tha thiết.
selfTerms: em (わたし, です/ます)

relations.relation: the prince she comes to beg for help
relations.address: em/hoàng tử (わたし/王子, です/ます) — tha thiết cầu xin, biết rõ thân phận thật của anh

relations.relation: the hero she hires for money
relations.address: em/anh (わたし) — khẩn khoản, hứa trả bao nhiêu cũng được

characters.name: Ukon
characters.role: The last and strongest of the three monsters ravaging Roots Island; pig-faced, endlessly boastful, and revealed mid-fight to be an immortal robot — beaten only when the islanders summon the legendary Manmora.
characters.personality: Loud, jeering and insufferably pleased with himself; genuinely touchy about being called a pig.
characters.speech: Booming laughter わはははは / うわはははは, blunt self term おれ, contemptuous のう endings. Snaps 'だれがブタじゃ!' when mocked for his face. In Vietnamese: giọng đại ca ngạo mạn 'tao/mày', cười lớn, cợt nhả.
selfTerms: tao (おれ)

relations.relation: the hero sent to drive him off the island
relations.address: tao/mày (おまえ) — khinh miệt, chê bai giữa trận ('なさけないのうおまえ'); cười lớn ngạo nghễ khi đòn Kinniku Flash bật ngược

characters.name: Iyadesu Harisun
characters.role: Chairman of the Superhuman Council (超人評議会 / WSC), which holds the East and South. He fronts the press after his champions are beaten one by one, blames the WSF, and devises the 踏絵 test — making 'Chanel Man' trample a portrait of King Muscle to prove he is not Kinnikuman, the trap that nearly exposes him.
characters.personality: Corporate and composed in public, quick to shift blame, and cruel in a procedural way — his 'test' turns into a beating while he admires the accuracy of the blows.
characters.speech: です/ます throughout, わたしたち when speaking for the body, あんた when questioning someone beneath him. In Vietnamese: a measured, official 'chúng tôi / tôi' with the flat courtesy of a spokesman.
selfTerms: chúng tôi (わたしたち, đại diện WSC)
tôi (わたし)

relations.relation: his champion
relations.address: tôi/Rhodes (gọi trống tên) — bàng hoàng gọi tên khi thấy anh ta bị đánh gục

relations.relation: the suspect he tests with his father's portrait
relations.address: tôi/anh (あんた) — dò hỏi lịch sự vừa phải, bên dưới là nghi ngờ

relations.relation: ally against the WSA, then rival over jurisdiction
relations.address: tôi/(không gọi tên, です/ます) — giữ lễ ngay cả khi tranh quyền

characters.name: Kẻ mặt đá
characters.role: Angular, rock-faceted lieutenant to Kinkotsuman in the Hero Olympics sabotage plot — scouts, reports back, and personally runs the 「ニイタカヤマノボレ」 operation, using a Monster Gun at a zoo to enlarge animals and loose them on a reception full of superhumans.
characters.personality: Sly and needling with his own side, ominously courteous to his targets.
characters.speech: Three registers by audience: teasing plain speech with his allies, deferential です/ます and 先生 to Kinkotsuman, and a chilling politeness to Kinnikuman, whom he greets by his real name — 「おまちしておりましたスグルさん」. In Vietnamese: giữ đúng ba bậc đó; chỗ lễ phép lạnh gáy với Kinnikuman là điểm nhấn.
selfTerms: tao (với đồng bọn)
em (với Kinkotsuman)
tôi (giả lễ phép với Kinnikuman)

relations.relation: his leader
relations.address: em/tiên sinh (先生, です/ます) khi báo cáo; suồng sã trêu lại khi thấy hắn cũng nhảy múa ăn mừng

relations.relation: the target he greets by his real name
relations.address: tôi/cậu Suguru (スグルさん) — lễ phép lạnh gáy, cho thấy hắn biết rõ thân phận thật

characters.name: Người tháp tùng của Rhodes (chưa rõ tên)
characters.role: The unnamed woman who accompanies Beauty Rhodes everywhere — the 'beautiful companion' Doro Flairs says every touring champion keeps. She speaks for him when he cannot: calming him in the crowd, screaming for help when Chanel Man floors him, facing down Sheik Seijin over his body, and finally declaring war on the WSF herself.
characters.personality: Cool and unimpressed at first, and the most clear-headed voice in the WSC camp once things turn violent — it is she, not the chairman, who names the WSF as the enemy.
characters.speech: Plain, curt, unafraid: calls Beauty Rhodes by bare name ローデス, and Sheik Seijin シーク to his face. In Vietnamese: a flat, level voice with no honorifics — she outranks nobody and defers to nobody. She has no name yet; keep her unnamed rather than inventing one.
selfTerms: tôi (plain, không kính ngữ)

relations.relation: the champion she accompanies and speaks for
relations.address: tôi/Rhodes (gọi trống tên) — thản nhiên khi trấn an, hét gọi khi hoảng

relations.relation: the enemy chairman she confronts over Rhodes' body
relations.address: tôi/Sheik (gọi trống tên) — lạnh, dò xét, rồi tuyên chiến

characters.name: Tabuchi
characters.role: Roots Island's self-styled 'last warrior' — the others died fighting the island's monsters. Plays childish pranks on Kinnikuman (darts, sabotage) and blames them on the local children.
characters.personality: Short-tempered and proud, secretly childish; breaks down frustrated ('くやしい') when caught out, but ends the arc speaking seriously about what makes a hero worth a legend.
characters.speech: Rough plain speech, self term オレ, calls Kinnikuman 王子. In Vietnamese: 'tao/mày' bốp chát khi phá đám, chuyển sang 'tôi/hoàng tử' khi nghiêm túc.
selfTerms: tao (オレ)
tôi (khi nói chuyện nghiêm túc)

relations.relation: the outsider hero he resents, pranks, then respects
relations.address: tôi/hoàng tử (オレ/王子) — trầm ngâm, động viên anh phải trở thành anh hùng xứng tầm truyền thuyết

characters.name: Xướng ngôn viên Hawaii
characters.role: The ringside announcer for the Hawaii matches, calling the Special Match and the double-title bout alongside the commentator Tazahama.
characters.personality: Professional and faintly weary — he has seen Kinnikuman's ridiculous ring entrances too many times to be impressed.
characters.speech: です/ます broadcast register with さん for his colleague, and a tired trailing ですねぇ when he editorialises. In Vietnamese: the polite, practised voice of a live commentator; keep the formality even when what he is describing is absurd.
selfTerms: tôi (です/ます, giọng nhà đài)

relations.relation: the commentator beside him at the desk
relations.address: tôi/anh Tazahama (タザハマさん, です/ます) — than thở thân mật trong lúc chờ trận
